tldr: Uranus through the 4th house disrupts home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 4th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
